main_text.p: Venire] Advenire domum, Plaut. Pervenire aliquo ad, in, Cic. Permanare aliquò. Perlabi supra solis orbem. Perlabi ad, Lucr. Ventitare domum alicujus. Devolare. Advolare, adesse ad judicium. Devenire ad, Cic. Devenire in, Hirt. Adventare, Cic. Aditare ad, Enn. Ventare, Fest.
Venire ad finem] Attingere calcem. Vid. Absolvere.
Venter] Alvus, abdomen, Cic. Profundum, Scal. Dolium pertusum, Fest. Ingluvies, Ter. Pantices, Plaut.
Ventris causa quidvis pati] E flamma cibum petere.

Ventilare] Ventilabris frumentum jactare, Col. Subjactare ventilabris, Var. Excernere flatu frumenta, Col. Evannare levissimum foras extra aream, Var. Eventilare. Vento separare, Col. Vannare frumentum, Lucil.

Ventilat aura aliquid] Sal. Permulcet flatu austri spiritus aram, Cic. Inspirantes ramis arborum auræ, Quint. Incursat in arborem ventus, Sen. Retrodat capillos aura. Sinuantur vestes flamine, Ovid. Aura dulcis spirat. Adspirant auræ, Virg. Undantem chlamydem quassando aliquis facit, Plaut.
Ventosus] Spiritalis. Spiritale genus machinæ. Pneumaticus, Vitr. Pneusticum dolium, Decalemp.

Ventrosus homo] Ventricosus. Ventriosus, Plaut. Promisso ventre, Col. Ventre projecto, projectiori, Suet. Prominulo, Iul. Capit. Ventre propenso, Perf. Homo cum collativo ventre, Plaut. Venter, abs. Panticib. laxis lanius, Mart. In ventrem crescit.
Venturus] Veniens: In annum venientem curas extendere, Virg. Futurum tempus. Appropinquante morte, Cic.

Ventus] Aëris fluxus, Plin. Fluor aëris, Arnob. Aëris fluens unda, Vitr. Agitando percitus aër, Lucr. Flatus, Cic. Spiritus, Col. Flabra, pro vento sumit, Suet. Flamina spirant, Ovid, Auræ, Id, Anima, pro vento, Virg. Æolus,

page.notes: Catchword "Æolus," at lower right is treated as the last line of text. Bottom of page blank otherwise. Some faint ink from the reverse page appears in the margins and was omitted.
